definitions.explanation: Refers to something written or mentioned earlier in a document or text. A formal written expression used in business correspondence, official documents, and academic writing.

examples.japanese: {上記|じょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{上記|じょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please send it to the address mentioned above.

examples.japanese: {上記|じょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧⟦いただける→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: If you agree to the conditions mentioned above, please sign.

notes:
USAGE: {上記|じょうき} is a formal written expression. It is rarely used in casual speech. In conversation, people typically say ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧ or {先|さき}ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上記|じょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (as stated above)
- {上記|じょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ (the above contents)
- {上記|じょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧ (the above address)
- {上記|じょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (the above conditions)

PAIR: The opposite is ⟦{下記|かき}→下記：11376_kaki⟧ (below-mentioned). These are often used together in documents: {上記|じょうき}...⟦{下記|かき}→下記：11376_kaki⟧...
